blocks.text: TORONTO — Kawhi Leonard is getting closer to rejoining the Toronto Raptors’ lineup. The Raptors announced Tuesday that Leonard “has successfully completed treatment to address left knee swelling,” the first step in the process to get him back on the court again. READ: Kawhi Leonard to miss at least a week left knee swelling Leonard played in Toronto’s first two games of the season, averaging 19.5 points and 7.5 rebounds. The Raptors have been without him since, going 2-3 in five contests. He’ll miss at least three more games while going through what the team called “the return to play” process […]...
